description: The REVAULTs project investigates the seismic response of masonry cross vaults through full-scale pseudo-dynamic testing. The European Commission Joint Research Centre describes a specimen representing an intermediate bay in the lateral nave of a three-nave historic church, with a focus on in-plane shear response. Zenodo confirms the named experimental resource and CC BY 4.0 rights, allowing free reuse. The top-level record does not establish the complete file formats, channel list or test dates. These measurements can support calibration of masonry-vault response simulations and retrofit assessments. One idealised specimen does not represent every historic church geometry, construction detail or degradation state. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: REVAULTs: Response Evaluation of masonry VAULTs under pseudo-dynamic loadings
